reviews.title: Great little stand
reviews.body: The legs are plastic but sturdy and the base is metal. It's perfect for my purposes of raising my laptop a little when I work in my home office. Really great value and a very functional piece!

reviews.title: Monitor Stand With a Few Minor Drawbacks
reviews.body: This computer monitor stand has been a really helpful addition to my workspace. The build quality is surprisingly sturdy, and it holds my monitor securely with zero wobble. The height it adds is perfect for improving posture—I’ve definitely noticed less neck strain after long work sessions. The surface area is wide enough for most monitors, and I love that there's enough space underneath to tuck away my keyboard or store small accessories. It keeps my desk noticeably cleaner and more organized.Assembly was simple and took only a few minutes, which I appreciated. The materials feel durable and well-made, not cheap or flimsy like some stands in this price range. The design is clean and modern, so it blends nicely with my setup without drawing too much attention.The only reason I didn’t give it five stars is that the stand could be just a bit more adjustable. A small range of height or angle options would have made it perfect. Also, the surface is prone to fingerprints, so I wipe it down more often than I expected.Overall, though, this is a great monitor stand that delivers solid value, improves comfort, and helps keep everything organized. A strong 4-star product that I’d happily recommend.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 20, 2025
reviews.author: Martin C.

reviews.title: Computer Monitor Stand is a great tool
reviews.body: The WALI Computer monitor stand that I got is light pink which matches other items on my work desk. I have my laptop sitting on top of it, 2 monitors beside and a keyboard in front of it with my cordless mouse to the right. It is a real space saver and helps posture and eyes. All my screens are now about the same level so it gives me much more comfort and ease going from screen to screen. It was super easy to put together and is height adjustable making it compatible with any device you’re using. I can slide items underneath if needed which saves space too. This stand was definitely worth the price.
